## Description
**What**: Update plugins/dso/scripts/create-dso-app.sh to apply the same single-stack-auto-default + multi-stack-confirm pattern as onboarding when scaffolding a new project.
**Why**: New-project adoption parity with the onboarding path.
**Scope**:
- IN: detect in-scope stacks; write default mutation.<stack>.enabled=true for detected stacks; copy mutation-testing.yml alongside other CI workflow templates; add tickets-branch push permission to the CI auth section; post a coordination ticket comment on d765-a3b6-84bd-4816 noting 411b's setup-script touchpoints.
- OUT: /dso:onboarding integration (draft-5).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, create-dso-app.sh detects in-scope stacks and writes mutation.<stack>.enabled=true to the scaffolded dso-config.conf for each detected stack using the single-stack-auto-default and multi-stack-confirm pattern ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, create-dso-app.sh copies mutation-testing.yml into the scaffolded .github/workflows/ alongside other CI workflow templates and adds the tickets-branch push permission to the CI auth section ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, a coordination ticket comment is posted on d765-a3b6-84bd-4816 noting 411b's create-dso-app.sh touchpoints ← Satisfies: sc-7
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic (stack detection, config writes, workflow copy, CI-auth-section edit) ← Satisfies: sc-7

## Considerations

- [Coordination] If d765-a3b6-84bd-4816's create-dso-app.sh rewrite ships first, integrate on top of it; if 411b ships first, the rewrite must preserve these hooks — coordinate via the ticket comment.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a developer scaffolding a new DSO project, I want create-dso-app.sh to set up mutation testing for detected stacks, so that new projects ship with mutation-testing wiring by default.
